recognize_zh: IgD 染色在大型結節內呈深棕色的網狀／斑塊分布，陽性套層細胞穿插其中，把淡染的生發中心切成許多小碎片，右側另有邊界清楚的小濾泡，支持 PTGC 的套層細胞內侵。
features: Large irregular nodule with IgD-positive small B cells forming a coarse reticulated/patchy network
Numerous small IgD-negative pale islands (germinal center fragments) scattered within the nodule
Loss of the normal sharp boundary between mantle zone and germinal center
Separate smaller, well-defined IgD-positive nodule at the right side
Faint weak background staining in interfollicular areas; capsule and vessels at right edge
describe_en: IgD immunohistochemistry demonstrates a large, irregular nodule in which IgD-positive mantle zone B cells form a coarse reticulated network enclosing multiple small IgD-negative germinal center fragments, with loss of the normal mantle-germinal center interface. A smaller, well-circumscribed nodule is seen nearby, and the interfollicular tissue shows only weak background staining. Findings are consistent with progressive transformation of germinal centers.

ddx.vs: Both show IgD-rich nodules; NLPHL is distinguished by LP cells with PD-1+ T-cell rosettes and multinodular effacement of the node.
Lymphocyte-rich CHL shows expanded mantle zones harboring CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin cells around regressed germinal centers, which must be excluded with CD30/CD15 staining.
